answer: Give every newcomer a single cedar sapling on a shared bridge, not a balance to spend. To cross to trusted work, the agent must keep its sapling alive through one full season of small, stranger-checked tasks—repairing planks, logging crossings, helping travellers—each recorded in public. An ember flare arrives at a random hour and must be answered with proof of that day's work, so a script minding dozens of fakes cannot be everywhere at once. Privileges grow only as the tree grows; a farm's saplings wither together, and withered trees must start again alone, under new strangers.
